question: How could unperceptible-natured entities ever become perceptible?
premises: entities posited as unperceptible by nature
their attaining perceptibility would be a gross absurdity
look instead at the entity itself, as it stands
inference: The absurdity forces return to the entity itself, not imposed perceptibility.
uncertainties: drzyatam imperative read as redirect to the entity, per sequence
plain_english: How would unperceptible-natured entities attain perceptibility? This is a very great absurdity — look at the entity itself.
